title: Quote Without Login
description: SwiftCargo lets anyone window-shop a price before committing to an account. Confirm the quote calculator really doesn't require authentication, unlike the booking-creation endpoint right next to it.
successCondition: POST /api/booking/quote with a valid origin/destination/package body and no Authorization header returns 200 with a full breakdown (baseFeeCents, weightFeeCents, distanceFeeCents, priceCents, currency). The same body sent to POST /api/booking with no Authorization header instead returns 401.
hints: Use two real freight hub coordinates from GET /api/booking/geocode for origin/destination so the distance calculation isn't degenerate.
This is the one endpoint in the booking module explicitly documented as public — every other route requires auth.
